subject: FinCo security follow-up: SOC 2 Type II & portal access
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@finco.com>, Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@procureco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: FinCo security follow-up: SOC 2 Type II & portal access

Hi Emma / Jacob —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the procurement conversation forward: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned the audit run completed fieldwork in Q4 2025 and that the Type II report is in finalization with the auditor. If possible, can you share either the completed Type II PDF or a signed bridge letter describing the scope and interim controls?
- Trust portal: you referenced a customer trust portal where evidence and attestation docs live — could we get an invite or a secure link so our compliance team can review the artifacts?
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): FinCo asked for us to complete a VSQ. I can send our filled VSQ and a concise tech pack (network diagram + data flow) and Monica (cc'd) will handle any evidence pulls.

Concrete asks: 
1) Please either attach the SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter by EOD next Wednesday (2026-06-17).
2) Send a trust portal invite or temporary access details for security@redwoodinference.com and lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com.
3) If you prefer, send the link to your VSQ and we'll submit within two business days.

I've attached a short guide (redwood_vsq_template.pdf) that shows what evidence we typically need to expedite reviews. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: redwood_vsq_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@finco.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@procureco.com>, FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: FinCo security follow-up: SOC 2 Type II & portal access

Hi Connor —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from our side:

- SOC 2: our most recent audit covered calendar 2025 and fieldwork wrapped in December 2025. The auditor is completing reporting now; we expect a final Type II report in late June.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter referencing the audit window and the status of the final report immediately. I will route that to our legal/security team for signature.
- Trust portal: we use FinCo Trust (internal) for evidence sharing. I can generate a limited-access invite for the two emails you listed (security@redwoodinference.com and lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com). Access will allow view/download of selected evidence items only.
- VSQ: please send the vendor questionnaire. If you can upload the completed VSQ to the portal, that speeds things up.

Target timeline: bridge letter and portal invite by Monday 2026-06-15; if there is any delay I will update you.

Best,
Emma Taylor
Senior Procurement Manager | FinCo Payments
emma.taylor@finco.com

Attachment: none

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T17:15:00Z
Subject: Re: FinCo security follow-up: SOC 2 Type II & portal access

Thanks Emma — that timeline works. We'll get our VSQ filled and uploaded. Monica (cc) will coordinate the evidence list.

Monica / Lauren — can you confirm the specific artifact set we should request from FinCo? Typical items: 
- SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter (requested)
- System architecture diagram + network controls (diagram + short description)
- Encryption at rest/in transit confirmation and KMS details
- Data retention & deletion policy excerpt relevant to customer data
- Incident response contact and most recent penetration test summary (if available)

Monica: I'll send you the VSQ link once I have the blank form from FinCo. LMK if you want to set a follow-up slot to triage after it's uploaded.

Connor

If they provide a signed bridge letter we can accept that in lieu of the final PDF for contracting purposes (legal sign-off pending final report).

Also flagging two technical items we may need: temporary access method (SAML/OneLogin user invite vs time-limited URL) and any NDA that FinCo requires for portal access. Connor — if FinCo provides the VSQ link, please drop it into the HubSpot record and ping me; I'll triage evidence pulls and start drafting the tech pack.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
